title: Stakeholders National Consultation meeting (for revision of NLEM 2015) will be held on 17/ 08/2020 through Video Conferencing
bodyHtml:
Standing National Committee on Medicine (SNCM)

Stakeholders National Consultation meeting

(for revision of NLEM 2015) will be held on 17/ 08/2020 through Video Conferencing

Venue: Department of Health Research (DHR), New Delhi

Date & Time: 17th August, 2020

A) Interaction with Pharmaceutical Association/NGO’s representatives – 10:00 - 11:30 AM

B) Interaction with Pharmaceutical Industries representatives -11:30 AM - 1:00 PM

Agenda:

1. Specific feedback/ comments on NLEM-2015

2. comments on Oncology Drugs

3. Comments on Anti-diabetic drugs and Drugs for Thyroid

Those interested may communicate the intent to participate by e-mail at: vc.sncmhcp@gmail.com

Link for video conferencing will be shared through e-mail.
